notes_for_editor: Two sources only: the register and a page of newspaper items. No source describes the site today or access to it. The 1935 article places the tower in the Rothrock forest district, but DCNR's current Rothrock State Forest page lists tracts only in Huntingdon, Centre and Mifflin counties, so the district may have changed since; not verified. A TopoQuest-style map listing (search snippet only, not fetched) still names a Shade Mountain Fire Tower in Juniata County; treat that as a map label. The 80-foot height is from the pre-completion announcement and is not in facts.
